en.title: Turn voice recordings into text notes you can actually search on iPhone, with Sono Note
en.meta: Nobody replays a recording. Pick the purpose, transcribe and tidy in one step, export to where you search. Sono Note does it on the iPhone, no account.
en.h1: Voice to text notes: how a recording becomes text you can find later
en.lead: The problem with recordings is never capturing them. It is that nobody listens again. The note only starts once the voice has become text.
en.answer: A recording is only findable once it is text: record on the iPhone, get a summary and key points right there, then export as text or Markdown into the notes tool you already search. Sono Note runs the whole flow on the device with no account.
paras: Start by deciding what the recording is for. A three-hour lecture, a client meeting and an idea that arrives while walking need three different kinds of text: a lecture needs key points and content you can search, a meeting needs action items and owners, a walking thought needs one clean paragraph. Decide which one you want first, or you will end up with a wall of raw transcript nobody reads.

Second, make transcription and tidying one action instead of two. Sono Note hands you a finished note the moment you stop: a summary, key points, action items and a follow-up email ready to send, with the original recording kept inside the note so you can replay a passage instead of the whole thing. There are ready templates for classes, client calls, interviews, doctor visits and ideas, and everything happens on the iPhone with no account, so it keeps working in airplane mode or a subway tunnel.

Third, make the text findable. Export the note as text or Markdown and put it where you already search, whether that is Notes or the company drive, so next week a keyword brings back the deadline someone mentioned. The free tier gives 3 notes a day at up to 3 minutes each, enough to test how well your speaking style transcribes; longer recordings and PDF export come with Pro, a one-time purchase with no subscription.

en.title: Learn five words a day on the commute and keep the streak, with Wordmate Lite: Vocabulary
en.meta: Daily vocabulary dies on day three because the dose is wrong. Five words, one subway stop, no decks. Wordmate Lite: Vocabulary works offline, no account.
en.h1: Daily vocabulary: why it stops on day three, and the five-word fix
en.lead: Adults restarting English, Japanese or Korean rarely lack material. What they lack is a daily action too small to skip.
en.answer: Cut the daily dose to five words, attach it to a slot that already exists (the subway ride to work), and make sure it needs no internet and no preparation; that is how a streak survives. Wordmate Lite: Vocabulary is built around exactly that: open it, walk five words, done, offline, no account.
paras: Stopping on day three is rarely laziness; it is usually the wrong dose. Day one is enthusiastic and you do thirty words. Day two you are rushed, manage ten, and feel you have lost. Day three you do not open the app. Drop the daily goal to five words so that even the worst day is finishable, and the streak stays alive, which matters far more than one heroic day of twenty.

The second key is tying practice to a moment that needs no decision. Between tapping in and tapping out on the subway, queueing at the convenience store, waiting for the bus: these one-minute gaps already exist, so you never have to find time. Wordmate Lite: Vocabulary is designed for those gaps. The screen is a trail of pebbles; step over five and the day is done, with the closing screen listing exactly the five words you just learned. Everything runs offline, so a tunnel with no signal changes nothing, and there is no account and no personal data collected.

Third, do not build your own flashcards. People restarting a language most often stall at sorting out a deck first, and never start. Pick a path you will actually use, business for a trip for work, travel for next month in Tokyo, begin at beginner level, and save any word worth keeping with a tap; saved words are grouped by topic and level. The free tier keeps one language and one path open at beginner level, enough to build the habit; when it sticks, a single one-time purchase unlocks all 44 languages, 14 paths and every level, with no subscription.

en.title: How to open a password-protected ZIP, RAR or 7z on iPhone with Zipbox: Unzip RAR, ZIP & 7z
en.meta: Files only opens plain ZIPs; a password-protected ZIP, RAR or 7z needs another app. Save it, enter the password, take one file. Zipbox works on device, no ads.
en.h1: How to open a password-protected ZIP, RAR or 7z on iPhone, step by step
en.lead: Files shows the archive, but tapping it does nothing, or only offers to share it. This page starts from the moment the file arrives and ends with the one item you needed.
en.answer: The built-in Files app only extracts plain ZIPs; a password-protected ZIP, and any RAR or 7z, will not open. You do not need an upload-and-extract website: install an extractor that works on the device, open the archive from Files or the share sheet, enter the password, look inside and pull out only what you need. Zipbox: Unzip RAR, ZIP & 7z is that kind of app, with no network, no ads and one purchase for every feature.
paras: First make sure the file is actually on the phone. An archive received in a chat app has to be opened in the conversation and saved with Save to Files; a Gmail attachment is long-pressed and saved the same way; a Safari download lands in the Downloads folder of Files. The most common dead end is a file that was never downloaded at all, just an icon in a chat window.

Then look at the extension. A .zip with no password opens with a tap in Files; a password-protected .zip, .rar or .7z needs another app. Two things matter when choosing one: explicit support for password-protected and multi-part archives, and processing that stays on the device. Zipbox: Unzip RAR, ZIP & 7z handles password-protected and multi-part ZIP, RAR and 7z, lets you browse the file list without extracting, preview photos, PDFs and text, and pull out only the item you want; it makes no network requests, has no account and no ads, and is a paid App Store download where one purchase includes every feature.

Finally, safety. A school or employer sends a password-protected archive precisely because it holds personal data or grades, and dropping it into an online extractor hands over both the password and the contents. Extracting on the phone keeps the file and the password on the device; when you need to share the result, send it back through the same mail or chat it came from.

In Files, long-press the archive, choose Share and pick Zipbox; or open Zipbox and browse to that folder.
Enter the password you were given. For multi-part archives, check first that every .part file is in the same folder.
Browse the list and preview photos or PDFs, then tick only the files you actually need instead of extracting everything.
Export the extracted files to Files or iCloud Drive, then send them back through the same chat or email.

en.h1: One-page summary: getting tonight's 16:9 slide out of a thirty-page report
en.lead: The review is tomorrow morning, you have a thirty-page report and an hour of meeting notes, and your manager wants one page. The problem is not layout; it is deciding what survives.
en.answer: Start with a single conclusion sentence, pick at most three numbers or points that support it, then let the visual follow the data: numbers become a column or line chart, steps a process flow, dates a timeline. OnePage PPT: AI Slide Maker distils pasted text, screenshots or a PDF into one 16:9 slide and exports an editable .pptx, all on the device.
paras: Write the conclusion first. Flip to the end of the report and answer the question so what in one sentence, such as Q3 renewals recovered, driven by enterprise accounts. That sentence is the slide title and everything else serves it. If you cannot write it, you have not understood the material yet, and no template will fix that.

Then choose the supports. Three at most: one set of numbers, one comparison, one timeline. Feed the matching paragraphs, table screenshots or PDF pages straight into OnePage PPT: AI Slide Maker, which pulls out the key points and picks the right visual: numbers become column or line charts, steps become a process flow, two options become a comparison, and it only draws a chart the data can honestly support, never inventing figures. Once the first draft is up, try the one-tap redesigns such as Cleaner or More Professional to see a few directions, lock the elements you like and rebuild around them.

Last, the delivery format. If someone else has to keep editing, export an editable .pptx with live text boxes and charts that open in PowerPoint, Keynote or Google Slides; if it is going into a group chat to be read, a PDF or high-resolution PNG is safer because nobody needs office software installed. Everything is processed on the device, so the report and screenshots are never uploaded, there is no account and no queue. You can try it free, and Lifetime Pro is a single purchase, not a subscription.

en.title: Save links from WeChat, Xiaohongshu and the browser with SaveTag: AI Social Bookmarks, no account
en.meta: Links vanish because they sit in each app's favourites with no tags. One place, tags on save, a few read daily. SaveTag saves from the share sheet, no account.
en.h1: Saving links you can actually find again: WeChat, Xiaohongshu and the browser in one place
en.lead: Saved in WeChat, favourited in Xiaohongshu, bookmarked in Safari: three piles in three apps, and when you need one, none of them turns up.
en.answer: Links disappear because they are scattered across each app's own favourites and were saved without tags. The fix is one collection that needs no account, tags written automatically on save, and a read-later rhythm that clears a few items a day. SaveTag: AI Social Bookmarks works exactly that way: one tap from the share sheet or clipboard, tags written on the device, no sign-up.
paras: First, drop the habit of saving wherever you happen to be reading. WeChat articles, Xiaohongshu notes and browser pages each have their own favourites, and three months later you cannot remember which app holds that recipe. Change the rule: anything worth keeping, from any app, goes to the same place. In a WeChat article use the top-right menu and Copy Link, in a Xiaohongshu note use Copy Link from its share options, and in the browser use the share sheet directly.

Second, let the tags write themselves. Manual filing never survives a week, so choose a tool that files each save the moment it lands. SaveTag: AI Social Bookmarks takes a share from any app with a share sheet and also quick-saves straight from the clipboard after you copy a URL; title, source site and preview come in automatically, and each save is sorted on the device into precise topics such as shopping, recipes, travel, parenting and finance, which you can correct or extend with custom tags. When you look for something later, search runs across titles, notes, tags and sources, so a vague memory is enough.

Third, actually come back. A read-later pile turns into a black hole when the list has no exit. SaveTag's Rediscover surfaces a small handful of unread saves each day, with a goal ring and a streak, and you tick each one off as you read it, so the list shrinks instead of growing. Everything stays on the iPhone: no account, no cloud, no ads. The free tier has every feature and keeps your latest 5 saves; SaveTag Pro is a one-time purchase that unlocks unlimited saves, custom tags and Markdown export, with no subscription.

loc.h1: 흐린 사진 복구: 흔들린 아이 사진, 아이폰 안에서 살리는 법
loc.lead: 아이가 움직여서, 강아지가 뛰어서, 학원 알림장을 급하게 찍어서 흐려진 사진은 지우기 아깝죠. 어떤 흐림인지에 따라 쓰는 모드가 달라요.
loc.answer: 흐린 사진은 원인별로 다른 보정을 써야 해요. 손떨림과 초점 흐림은 샤픈, 어두운 실내 사진은 저조도, 알림장과 영수증은 문서 모드, 작게 찍힌 사진은 업스케일이 맞아요. Unblurry Pro: 흐림 보정은 이 모드를 전부 iPhone 안에서만 처리해서 사진이 폰 밖으로 나가지 않아요.
paras: 먼저 사진을 확대해서 흐림의 종류를 봐요. 아이 얼굴 윤곽이 한 방향으로 끌려 있으면 손떨림이나 움직임, 전체가 고르게 뿌옇면 초점 흐림, 어둡고 알갱이가 거칠면 저조도 노이즈예요. 카톡으로 받은 사진이 작고 뭉개져 보이는 건 흐림이 아니라 전송 중에 해상도가 줄어든 것이라, 확대 쪽 보정이 맞아요.

종류를 알면 모드를 고르면 돼요. Unblurry Pro: 흐림 보정에는 자동 선명화, 샤픈, 노이즈 제거, 저조도, 문서, AI 초해상도, 4× 업스케일, 인물 & 복원까지 8가지 모드가 있어요. 뛰어다니는 아이나 강아지 사진은 샤픈, 저녁 식당에서 찍은 사진은 저조도, 학원 알림장이나 계약서는 문서 모드로 글자를 또렷하게, 오래된 가족사진은 인물 & 복원이 맞아요. 처리는 전부 iPhone 안에서 이루어져서 아이 사진이 서버로 올라가지 않고, 전/후 슬라이더를 길게 눌러 원본과 바로 비교할 수 있어요.
마지막은 저장 방식이에요. 매일 무료로 사진을 향상하고 저장할 수 있고, 워터마크 없이 원본 전체 해상도로 내보내려면 Unblurry Pro를 한 번만 결제하면 돼요. 구독이 아니라 한 번의 구매이고, 광고도 추적도 없어요. 결과가 너무 날카로워 보이면 자동 선명화로 한 번 더 돌려 보는 쪽이 자연스러워요.

en.title: Fix a blurry photo of a child on iPhone without uploading it, with Unblurry Pro: Unblur & HD
en.meta: Each blur needs its own fix: Sharpen for shake, Low Light for dark rooms, Document for notes. Unblurry Pro: Unblur & HD runs on the iPhone, no subscription.
en.h1: Fixing a blurry photo: rescuing a shaky shot of your child right on the iPhone
en.lead: A child who moved, a dog mid-jump, a school notice photographed in a hurry: too blurry to use, too precious to delete. Which mode you reach for depends on what kind of blur it is.
en.answer: Different blur needs different treatment. Shake and soft focus want Sharpen, dark indoor shots want Low Light, notices and receipts want Document, and a photo that arrived tiny wants Upscale. Unblurry Pro: Unblur & HD runs all of these on the iPhone itself, so the photo never leaves the phone.
paras: Start by zooming in to see what kind of blur you have. If the outline of a face is dragged in one direction, that is hand shake or movement; if the whole frame is evenly soft, that is focus; if it is dark and grainy, that is low-light noise. A photo that came through a chat app looking small and mushy is not blurred at all, it lost resolution in transit, so an upscaling mode is the right tool.

Once you know the type, pick the mode. Unblurry Pro: Unblur & HD has eight: Auto Clear, Sharpen, Denoise, Low Light, Document, AI Super Resolution, 4x Upscale and Portrait & Restore. A running child or dog wants Sharpen, a dinner shot in a dim restaurant wants Low Light, a school notice or contract wants Document to crisp up the text, and an old family photo wants Portrait & Restore. Everything is processed on the iPhone, so a photo of your child is never sent to a server, and you can press the before/after slider to peek at the original at any point.

The last question is how you save. You can enhance and save for free every day; to export without a watermark and at the full original resolution, you unlock Unblurry Pro once. It is a single purchase rather than a subscription, with no ads and no tracking. If a result looks over-sharp, running Auto Clear instead usually gives a more natural look.

Dark indoor photos: brighten with Low Light, then clean up any remaining grain with Denoise.
School notices and receipts: use Document to crisp the text, then zoom to 100% to check the numbers.
Photos that arrived small through a chat app: enlarge with 4x Upscale or AI Super Resolution first, then sharpen.
Before saving, press the before/after slider to compare with the original, and rerun with Auto Clear if it looks overdone.

Light shake improves visibly with Sharpen, but a face or text dragged a long way has limits. Try it free first and judge the result before unlocking.
Does Unblurry Pro: Unblur & HD upload my photos to a server?
No. All processing happens on the iPhone, with no cloud and no account. Your photos never leave the phone.

loc.h1: 2泊3日の旅程表：時間・場所・メモを1本のタイムラインに
loc.lead: 友人や家族との国内旅行は、予定が多すぎても少なすぎても疲れます。必要なのは、電車の中でさっと見返せる1本の時間軸です。
loc.answer: 日ごとに「出発時刻・移動・滞在先」を一列に並べ、各予定に住所と予約番号をメモとして添えるのが基本形です。1日に回る場所は3〜4か所までに絞ると、温泉でも京都でも無理なく動けます。
paras: まず骨組みは移動から作ります。新幹線や飛行機の時刻、ホテルのチェックイン時間を先に置き、その間に観光や食事を差し込むと、移動時間を見落とさずにすみます。沖縄ならレンタカーの返却時刻、京都なら拝観の受付終了時刻が、その日の長さを決める基準になります。

次に、各予定へ「現地で必要な情報」だけを添えます。予約番号、集合場所の目印、温泉旅館の夕食時間など、当日に探し回りたくないものです。TripBee Lite：旅程プランは、日ごとのタイムラインにフライト・宿泊・予定を並べ、メモやリマインダー、チケット情報を必要な場所にまとめられる旅行プランナーで、アカウント登録は不要、広告や解析、トラッキングもありません。無料版は一度に1件の旅を保存でき、予定の変更はいつでもできます。
最後に、同行者と見る前提で書きます。「10:00 清水寺」より「9:40 京都駅バス乗り場D1集合 → 10:15 清水寺」のほうが、当日の問い合わせが減ります。旅程は出発の前日に一度通しで読み、移動の間隔が20分を切る箇所があれば予定を1つ減らしてください。

en.title: How to plan a two-night trip itinerary in Japan with TripBee Lite: Trip Planner
en.meta: A 2–3 day trip to an onsen or Kyoto needs one day-by-day timeline with times, places and notes. TripBee Lite: Trip Planner, no account, no ads.
en.h1: A two-night itinerary: times, places and notes on one timeline
en.lead: A short trip with friends or family goes wrong when there is too much or too little in the plan. What you need is a single time axis you can glance at on the train.
en.answer: Line up departure time, transport and where you are staying for each day, attach the address and booking reference to every entry as a note, and cap each day at three or four places so an onsen town or Kyoto stays relaxed.
paras: Build the skeleton from transport first. Put shinkansen or flight times and the hotel check-in on the timeline before anything else, then slot sightseeing and meals into the gaps so travel time is never forgotten. In Okinawa the rental-car return time sets the length of the day; in Kyoto it is the last admission time at the temples.

Next, attach only what you will need on the spot: booking numbers, a landmark for the meeting point, the dinner time at the ryokan. TripBee Lite: Trip Planner lays flights, hotels and plans on a day-by-day timeline and keeps notes, reminders and ticket references where they belong. No account is required, and there are no ads, analytics or tracking. The free app saves one journey at a time, and you can edit or replace it whenever plans change.

Finally, write it as if a companion will read it. '09:40 meet at Kyoto Station bus stop D1 → 10:15 Kiyomizu-dera' causes fewer questions on the day than '10:00 Kiyomizu-dera'. Read the whole plan once the evening before you leave; wherever two entries are less than 20 minutes apart, drop one.

Right after the hotel and transport are booked. Fill in the fixed times first and settle the sightseeing a week before departure so changes stay easy.
How do I keep the group on the same plan?
Put the meeting time and place in the entry title and have everyone read the same plan rather than relaying it verbally. A change should mean editing one line.
Is the free version of TripBee Lite: Trip Planner enough for a two-night trip?
The free app saves one journey at a time with a day-by-day timeline, notes, reminders and ticket references. Replace it with the next trip when you are done.

loc.title: 子どもと飛行機・新幹線、旅行ゲームは何を用意する？Trip Planet 子ども旅行ゲームで静かに遊ぶ
loc.meta: 4〜8歳と飛行機や新幹線に乗るなら、音を出さず短時間で区切れる遊びと、旅そのものを課題にするミッション型が相性抜群です。Trip Planet 子ども旅行ゲームは広告なし、買い切りです。
loc.h1: 子連れの飛行機・新幹線：旅行ゲームは「静か・短い・旅と結びつく」で選ぶ
loc.lead: 機内や車内で困るのは、ゲームの音と「まだ着かないの？」の繰り返しです。遊びが旅の中身とつながっていると、退屈が冒険に変わります。
loc.answer: 音なしで遊べて、5〜10分で一区切りつき、しかも「空港でチケットを見せる」「窓から3つの色を探す」のように旅そのものを課題にするゲームが、4〜8歳の移動時間にいちばん向いています。
paras: 準備の軸は3つです。ひとつ目は音。機内でも新幹線でも、効果音が鳴る遊びはイヤホンが外れた瞬間に周囲の目が集まります。ふたつ目は区切りの短さ。着陸前や乗り換えで途中終了しても泣かずに済むよう、1回が数分で終わるものを選びます。みっつ目は、画面の中だけで完結しないことです。

その3つ目を満たすのがミッション型の遊びです。Trip Planet 子ども旅行ゲームは、3〜10歳の子ども向けに、長いフライトや車移動、ホテルでの時間をミッションに変える旅行ミッションアプリです。旅行を作ってMission Packsを選ぶと、星座マップに「新しい食べ物に挑戦」「空港で勇気を出す」「美術館で3つの色を探す」といった小さな課題が並び、達成するとごほうびとパスポートのスタンプが集まります。広告なし、第三者トラッキングなし、外部サーバーもなく、買い切りでサブスクリプションではありません。
当日の運用は、乗る前に「今日のミッションは3つ」と決めて見せることです。離陸や発車の直後に1つ、落ち着いた頃に1つ、降りる前に1つ。親が端末を持つ場面でも、ふたりの保護者がそれぞれの端末で同じ旅を共有できる仕組みなら、交代しても進み具合がずれません。

en.title: Kids travel games for a flight or shinkansen ride with Trip Planet: Kids Quest
en.meta: Flying or on the bullet train with a 4–8 year old? Pick play that is silent, short and makes the journey the game. Trip Planet: Kids Quest, no ads.
en.h1: Travel games for kids on a plane or train: silent, short, tied to the trip
en.lead: What goes wrong in a cabin is noise and the endless 'are we there yet'. When the play is about the trip itself, boredom turns into an adventure.
en.answer: The best games for a 4–8 year old in transit make no sound, finish in five to ten minutes and use the journey as the challenge: show the ticket at the gate, find three colours out of the window, try a new food.
paras: Plan around three things. First, sound: on a plane or a train, any game with sound effects draws stares the moment an earbud falls out. Second, short rounds: something that ends in a few minutes can be stopped for landing or a transfer without tears. Third, play that does not live entirely inside the screen.

Mission-style play covers that third point. Trip Planet: Kids Quest is a travel-missions app for children aged 3–10 that turns long flights, car rides and hotel stays into missions. Create a trip, choose Mission Packs, and small real-world quests appear on a constellation map: try a new food, be brave at the airport, spot three colours at a museum. Completed missions unlock rewards and a passport stamp for every finished trip. There are no ads, no third-party tracking and no external servers, and it is a one-time purchase, not a subscription.

On the day, announce 'three missions today' before boarding. One right after take-off or departure, one once things settle, one before you get off. If both parents take turns holding the phone, a trip that two parents share from their own devices keeps the progress in sync.

faq: Is there anything to set up before boarding?

Create the trip and pick the Mission Packs before you leave so the game can start as soon as you sit down. Trip Planet: Kids Quest uses no external servers and shares the trip between parents through iCloud.
Can a four-year-old understand the missions?
Yes, when a task fits in one sentence, such as 'say thank you' or 'find three colours'. For a child who cannot read yet, read it aloud and confirm the result together.
Does Trip Planet: Kids Quest show ads or push purchases?
There are no ads and no third-party tracking. Purchases and sharing sit behind a parent gate, and it is a one-time purchase rather than a subscription.

loc.meta: 自宅・ホテル・カフェで「接続済みなのに開かない」とき、再起動の前に確認する順番があります。WiFi Aid Lite はDNS・TCP・TLSを同時にチェックし、最も可能性の高い原因を数秒で提示します。1回は無料です。
loc.h1: Wi-Fiはつながっているのにネットが使えない：原因は3つのどれか
loc.lead: 扇マークは出ているのにページが開かない。原因はルーター、DNS、プロバイダのどれかで、順番に見れば1分で見当がつきます。
loc.answer: まず別のサイトとIPアドレス直打ちで開くか試し、次にスマホのモバイル回線で同じサイトを開きます。名前解決だけ失敗すればDNS、IPでも開かなければルーターか回線、モバイルでも開かなければサイト側の問題です。
paras: 自宅では、ルーターが「つながっている」と言っているだけで、その先のプロバイダ側が落ちていることがよくあります。ホテルやカフェでは、ログイン画面（キャプティブポータル）が出ずに止まっているケースが大半です。まずブラウザで普段使わないサイトを開き、ログイン画面が出るかどうかを確かめてください。

次の段階は証拠集めです。名前解決（DNS）、接続（TCP）、暗号化（TLS）のどこで止まっているかがわかれば、再起動すべきなのがルーターなのか、変えるべきなのがDNS設定なのか、待つしかないプロバイダ障害なのかが決まります。WiFi Aid Lite は、ワンタップでWi-Fi・DNS・インターネット接続をまとめて診断し、DNS・TCP・TLS・応答時間を複数の独立した経路で同時にチェックして、最も可能性の高い原因を数秒で提示します。全ツール合わせて完全なチェックが1回無料で、気に入れば1回限りの買い切りで永久アンロック、サブスクリプションはありません。
「時々つながらない」タイプは一度の確認では見つかりません。遅延の揺らぎ（ジッター）を続けて観測し、過去の結果と比べる必要があります。履歴が端末内に残っていれば、プロバイダに問い合わせるときに「何時に、どの項目で失敗したか」を具体的に伝えられ、話が早く進みます。

en.title: Wi-Fi connected but no internet: router, DNS or provider? WiFi Aid Lite: Network Check
en.meta: 'Connected but nothing loads' has three usual causes: router, DNS or provider. Check in order before rebooting. WiFi Aid Lite: Network Check, one tap.
en.h1: Wi-Fi connected but no internet: which of the three is it
en.lead: The Wi-Fi icon is on and the page will not load. The cause is the router, DNS or the provider, and checking in order narrows it down in about a minute.
en.answer: Open a different site, then try an IP address directly, then open the same site on mobile data. If only the name lookup fails it is DNS; if the IP fails too it is the router or the line; if mobile data fails as well, the site itself is down.
paras: At home the router often reports 'connected' while the provider's side beyond it is down. In hotels and cafés the most common cause is a captive-portal login page that never appeared. Start by opening a site you do not normally visit in the browser and see whether a login page shows up.

The next stage is evidence. Knowing whether the name lookup (DNS), the connection (TCP) or the encryption (TLS) is the step that fails tells you whether to reboot the router, change the DNS setting or simply wait out a provider outage. WiFi Aid Lite: Network Check runs Wi-Fi, DNS and internet checks in one tap, gathers DNS, TCP, TLS and response-time evidence over several independent paths and points to the most likely cause within seconds. One complete check is free across all tools, and an optional one-time lifetime unlock gives unlimited use with no subscription.

Intermittent 'sometimes it drops' problems do not show up in a single check. You need repeated samples of latency variation and a way to compare with earlier results. A check history kept on the device lets you tell the provider exactly when and at which step the failure happened, which shortens the call.

For intermittent drops, collect stability samples and keep the history to show the provider.

Only when the router is the problem. If DNS, the provider or the website is the cause, no number of reboots will change anything, so find the failing step first.

loc.h1: Passfoto 35×45 mm selbst machen: Kopfgröße, Hintergrund, Druck auf 10×15
loc.lead: Ein Passfoto aus dem Automaten kostet Zeit, nicht Können. Mit Tageslicht, einer hellen Wand und einem exakten Zuschnitt gelingt es zu Hause – Sie müssen nur wissen, wofür ein Ausdruck noch reicht.
loc.answer: Fotografieren Sie frontal vor einer hellen, einfarbigen Wand bei Tageslicht, schneiden Sie auf 35×45 mm zu, richten Sie Scheitel, Augenlinie und Kinn an Hilfslinien aus und legen Sie mehrere Kopien auf einen 10×15-Bogen für den Drogerie-Ausdruck. Für den deutschen Reisepass und Personalausweis gilt seit Mai 2025 die digitale Übermittlung, dort hilft Ihnen kein Papierfoto mehr.
paras: Die meisten Ablehnungen kommen nicht vom Zuschnitt, sondern von der Aufnahme: Schatten hinter dem Kopf, ein geneigter Kopf, Haare vor den Augen oder ein Fenster, das eine Gesichtshälfte heller macht. Stellen Sie sich einen Meter vor eine helle, glatte Wand, lassen Sie das Tageslicht von vorn kommen und bitten Sie jemanden, aus Augenhöhe zu fotografieren. Neutraler Gesichtsausdruck, Mund geschlossen, Blick direkt in die Kamera.

Danach kommt der exakte Zuschnitt. Das Format 35×45 mm ist in Deutschland für Visumanträge, Führerschein, Bewerbungen und viele Ausweise verlangt, und die amtliche Fotomustertafel gibt vor, wie viel vom Bild das Gesicht einnehmen darf und wo die Augenlinie liegen soll. Snapport Lite schneidet Ihr Porträt direkt auf dem Gerät auf die gewählte Größe zu: Sie wählen die Vorlage 35×45 mm, richten das Gesicht an den Hilfslinien für Scheitel, Augenlinie und Kinn aus, wechseln den Hintergrund bei Bedarf zu Weiß oder Hellgrau und verfeinern die Kanten. Die Fotos werden nicht hochgeladen, die App funktioniert offline, alle Vorlagen und Werkzeuge sind kostenlos nutzbar, der erste Export ist inklusive, und ein einmaliger Kauf schaltet unbegrenzte Exporte frei – kein Abo, keine Werbung.

Für den Ausdruck brauchen Sie einen Druckbogen im Format 10×15 cm (4×6 Zoll) mit mehreren Kopien und Schnittmarken. Speichern Sie ihn als JPEG in Fotos, laden Sie die Datei am Fotodrucker bei dm oder Rossmann als normales 10×15-Foto und schneiden Sie zu Hause an den Marken. Wichtig: Für den deutschen Reisepass und Personalausweis nimmt das Bürgeramt seit dem 1. Mai 2025 nur noch digital übermittelte Fotos an, etwa vom zertifizierten Fotografen oder vom Terminal in der Behörde. Eine App bearbeitet nur das Bild; ob ein Foto angenommen wird, entscheidet immer die Stelle, bei der Sie es einreichen.

paras: Most rejections come from the shot, not the crop: a shadow behind the head, a tilted face, hair over the eyes or a window lighting one side of the face. Stand a metre in front of a pale, smooth wall, let daylight fall from the front and have someone photograph you from eye level. Neutral expression, mouth closed, eyes straight into the lens.

Then comes the exact crop. In Germany 35×45 mm is the format for visa applications, driving licences, job applications and many ID documents, and the official photo template sets how much of the frame the face may fill and where the eye line should sit. Snapport Lite crops your portrait to the chosen size right on the device: pick the 35×45 mm preset, line the face up with the head-top, eye-line and chin guides, switch the background to white or light grey if needed and refine the edges. Photos are never uploaded, the app works offline, every preset and tool is free to use, the first export is included, and a one-time purchase unlocks unlimited exports with no subscription and no ads.

For printing you need a 10×15 cm (4×6 in) sheet with several copies and cut guides. Save it as a JPEG to Photos, load it at the dm or Rossmann photo kiosk as an ordinary 10×15 print and cut along the marks at home. One important caveat: since 1 May 2025 German registration offices accept only digitally transmitted photos for passports and ID cards, from a certified photographer or the terminal at the office. An app only edits the picture; whether a photo is accepted is always decided by the office you submit it to.

en.lead: The device you no longer use has everything needed: a big screen, a charging port and a spot on the nightstand. The job is to stop it switching off and stop it dazzling you.
en.answer: Plug the device in, pick a clock app that keeps the screen on while charging, switches to a dark face at night and protects OLED panels, then lower the brightness to the lowest level you can still read from the pillow.
paras: The first obstacle is auto-lock: iOS turns the screen off after a few minutes, and setting it to Never in Display & Brightness keeps an unplugged old device awake until the battery dies in a few hours. Better to use a clock that understands charging: on while the cable is in, or above a battery floor you set.

The second point is the night itself. A white face at 3 a.m. wakes you, and on an OLED panel digits that never move all night eventually leave marks. Stay Clock: Flip Desk Clock turns your iPhone or iPad into an always-on clock: Keep Awake while charging with a battery floor or the system setting, a night schedule that switches to a dim red face on true black, and gentle pixel shifting to spare OLED screens. One complete face is included free, with no account, ads or tracking; an optional Lifetime purchase adds 100 more faces, with no subscription.

Finally, think about placement and sound. In landscape an iPad reads from across the bedroom; in portrait an iPhone fits a narrow shelf. The hourly chime can stay off at night, and a simple alarm saves opening another app in the morning. Wipe the screen before you set the device down: a fingerprint stands out on a black background.

loc.title: Облік часу навчання перед НМТ: години, серія днів і темп до іспиту зі Studydown: Облік часу
loc.meta: Готуєтеся до НМТ? Рахуйте реальні години, а не плани. Studydown: Облік часу рахує час, поки телефон лежить екраном донизу, і показує темп до іспиту.
loc.h1: Облік часу навчання перед іспитом: що рахувати і як не кидати
loc.lead: Розклад на папері каже, скільки Ви збиралися вчити. Облік часу каже, скільки Ви вчили насправді, і саме ця різниця вирішує результат НМТ.
loc.answer: Рахуйте лише час без телефона в руках, розбитий за предметами, і порівнюйте його з денним темпом, потрібним до дати іспиту. Серія днів поспіль важливіша за рекордні суботи: 40 хвилин щодня дають більше, ніж 6 годин раз на тиждень.
paras: Почніть із того, що саме Ви записуєте. Година з відкритим підручником і стрічкою новин у руці — не година навчання. Найчесніший спосіб обліку — запускати відлік лише тоді, коли телефон лежить екраном донизу, і зупиняти його, щойно Ви його піднімаєте. Так у підсумку дня залишається тільки час, за який Вам справді не соромно.

Далі потрібні три числа: сьогодні, цей тиждень і скільки ще лишилося до іспиту. Studydown: Облік часу записує час для кожного заняття, коли Ви кладете телефон екраном донизу на стіл, показує підсумки дня й тижня, кількість днів поспіль і розподіл між заняттями. Для кожного кінцевого терміну, наприклад дати НМТ, можна задати часову ціль і бачити записаний час та потрібний денний темп. Вимірювання працює на пристрої, без облікового запису й реклами; безкоштовно можна спробувати до 3 занять і загалом 5 хвилин запису, а одноразова купівля Pro відкриває необмежений запис, цілі, терміни й віджети — без підписки.

Нарешті, зробіть облік таким, щоб його хотілося продовжувати. Заведіть окремі заняття для української мови, математики та історії, задайте тижневу ціль, яку реально виконати в навчальний тиждень, і дивіться на серію днів, а не на суму. Якщо день пропущено, запишіть це чесно — нуль хвилин теж запис, і він підказує, де графік не витримує.

en.title: Track study hours and the exam deadline for NMT prep with Studydown: Face-Down Timer
en.meta: Preparing for the NMT or a certification? Count real hours, not plans. Studydown: Face-Down Timer logs face-down time and shows the pace to the exam.
en.h1: Tracking study time before an exam: what to count and how to keep going
en.lead: A paper schedule says how much you meant to study. A time log says how much you actually did, and that gap decides the exam result.
en.answer: Count only time with the phone out of your hands, split by subject, and compare it with the daily pace required before the exam date. A run of consecutive days beats record Saturdays: 40 minutes every day adds up to more than six hours once a week.
paras: Start with what you record. An hour with the textbook open and a news feed in your hand is not an hour of study. The most honest method is to start the count only when the phone lies face down and stop it the moment you pick it up, so the day's total contains only time you can stand behind.

Then you need three numbers: today, this week and how much is left before the exam. Studydown: Face-Down Timer records time for each activity when you place the phone face down on the desk, shows today and this week, consecutive days and a breakdown by activity. Each deadline, such as the NMT date, can carry an effort target so you see logged time and the daily pace still required. Timing works on the device with no account or ads; the free allowance covers up to 3 activities and 5 recorded minutes in total, and a single Pro purchase unlocks unlimited recording, goals, deadlines and widgets with no subscription.

Finally, make the log something you want to keep. Create separate activities for Ukrainian, maths and history, set a weekly goal you can actually meet in a school week, and watch the run of days rather than the grand total. If you skipped a day, record it honestly: zero minutes is also an entry, and it shows where the schedule breaks.

There is no universal figure. Divide the hours left before the exam date by the number of days and hold that pace; a regular 40–60 minutes per subject each day works better than rare marathons.

Record the gap honestly and start a new run the next day. The point of the log is to see which weekday the schedule breaks on and remove the cause, not to punish yourself.

loc.title: 戒手機怎麼開始？不靠意志力的 7 天計畫
loc.meta: 戒手機會失敗，多半是第一天就想全部戒掉。先量兩天、再鎖一個時段、最後才處理睡前和起床。這份 7 天計畫每天只改一件事。LockHour Pro 把選定的 App 鎖到時間結束，一次購買解鎖全部功能，不訂閱。
loc.h1: 戒手機 7 天計畫：每天只改一件事，不用靠意志力
loc.lead: 戒手機常見的失敗方式，是第一天把社群 App 全部刪掉，第三天全部裝回來。撐得過一週的做法剛好相反：每天只改一件事，而且先改環境，不改決心。
loc.answer: 第 1 到 2 天只用 iPhone 內建的「螢幕使用時間」量出前三名 App 和每天拿起次數；第 3 天起每天鎖一個 25 到 50 分鐘的時段；第 5、6 天把睡前一小時和起床後半小時也鎖起來；第 7 天對照數字，決定哪幾條規則留下。
paras: 第 1 到第 2 天只做一件事：量。打開「設定」→「螢幕使用時間」，看常用的前三名 App 和每天拿起手機的次數，把數字抄下來。多數人會發現真正吃掉時間的不是五個 App，而是一到兩個。這兩天不用改任何習慣，只要知道對手是誰。
第 3 到第 4 天開始鎖時段。選一段你本來就想專心的 25 到 50 分鐘，例如午餐後或晚上八點，在那段時間把前三名 App 鎖住，時間到自動解開。重點是「時段」而不是「永遠」：知道一小時後就能滑，大腦比較不會反抗。第 5 到第 6 天再把睡前一小時和起床後三十分鐘加進去，這兩段是一天裡手機時間漲得特別快的地方。
第 7 天回頭看數字：拿起次數有沒有少、前三名的時間有沒有降。有效的規則留下，沒效的刪掉，下週再加一條。LockHour Pro 做的就是這件事：開始一個專注時段，選定的 App 立刻被鎖住，時間到自動解鎖；「睡前放鬆」和「晨間重啟」兩個模式對應第 5、6 天，每週圖表和連續紀錄讓第 7 天的回顧有數字可看。不需要帳號、沒有廣告。

en.h1: Study timer with phone blocking: making 25 minutes actually last 25 minutes
en.lead: The paradox of a study timer is that it lives on the phone. Picking it up to start the clock also surfaces the notifications and the feed. So the timer and the block cannot be separate tools; they have to switch on together.
en.answer: Make the tap that starts the timer also lock the distracting apps, and treat four rounds of 25 minutes on, 5 off, followed by a 20 minute break, as one set. Block only three apps to begin with, and let the session release them automatically when it ends.
paras: First choose what to block. Block everything and you will switch it off within three days, so pick only the three apps you actually opened while studying last week. For most students two of them are YouTube, Instagram or the family chat app. The chat app feels hard to include, but a reply delayed by 25 minutes almost never causes a real problem.

Next is length. For the first week, run 25 minutes of focus and 5 of rest, four rounds, then a 20 minute break: that is one two-hour set. For subjects where the flow must not break, such as mock exams or long reading passages, switch to 50 on, 10 off, but cap it at two sets a day. If the 5 minute break goes to the phone, the next 25 minute round shrinks to about 10, so decide in advance what the break is for: water, a stretch, anything that does not need the phone.

Last, check whether the timer and the block switch on together. Kept separate, one of them always gets skipped, and the one that gets skipped is the block. In LockHour Pro, the single tap that starts a session shields the chosen apps instantly and releases them when time is up. Study Mode runs the Pomodoro-style cycles with breaks, and the Lock Screen widget and Dynamic Island show the remaining time so there is no reason to open the phone to check. en.title: Kids alphabet: which order to teach the letters at home
en.meta: Name letters first, b and d kept apart, three letters a week, ten minutes a day, then a tracing sheet. Lumi Letters Lite: free to start, one-time unlock.
en.h1: Teaching the alphabet at home: a letter order and tracing-sheet plan for preschoolers
en.lead: Singing the ABC song is not the same as knowing the letters. Singing is memorising a tune; knowing a letter means hearing its sound, pointing to its shape and tracing its strokes. And the order does not have to be A to Z.
en.answer: Group three or four letters that look and sound clearly different (s, a, t, p is a good first set), spend ten minutes a day on "hear the name and sound, point to it among three, trace uppercase then lowercase", and print a tracing sheet of only today's letters to redo on paper. Twenty-six letters take roughly eight to ten weeks.
paras: The ABC song is ordered for singing, not for learning. When b and d, p and q, or m and n arrive back to back, a three- or four-year-old blends them together and you spend weeks pulling them apart again. It goes more smoothly if you begin with the letters in the child's own name, then build groups from letters whose shapes and sounds are clearly different, leaving at least two weeks between any confusable pair.

Three or four letters per group and ten minutes a day is enough; past fifteen minutes attention is gone. Give every letter the same three actions: hear its name and its sound, point to it among three letters, then trace it, uppercase first because straight lines are easier to start. Only when all three are solid do you add a reverse check, "hear the sound, find the letter". Do not skip ahead.

After tracing on screen, trace once more on paper so the movement stays in the hand. The sheet should show a starting point and stroke order, and it should contain only today's letters, not the whole alphabet. In Lumi Letters Lite every letter has its name and sound, uppercase and lowercase tracing with real stroke order and crosshair guide lines, plus a listen-and-tap challenge; the full version exports a PDF worksheet with one tap that already contains the letters practised today and tracing grids ready to print. Letters A to D are free to play.

steps: Write down the letters in your child's name as the first group; top it up to four with distinct shapes such as s, a, t, p.
Split the remaining letters into six or seven groups of three or four, keeping b/d, p/q, m/n and n/u in different groups at least two weeks apart.
Same time every day, ten minutes: hear name and sound, point to the letter among three, trace uppercase then lowercase, once per letter.
At the end of the day print a sheet with only today's letters, trace each three times with a thick marker from the starting dot, and stick it on the fridge.
After five days on a group, run a reverse check: you say the sound, the child finds the letter. Two out of three correct means move on; otherwise give the group three more days.

At three, listening to names and sounds and pointing to letters is enough. Tracing waits until the child can hold a pencil and draw a straight line and a circle, usually around four. There is no need to rush tracing at three; get hearing and pointing solid first.
Uppercase or lowercase first?

Trace uppercase first because the strokes are mostly straight and easy to start. For hearing and recognising, show both cases together, since books are mostly lowercase. Do both within the same letter group rather than as two separate phases.

loc.title: С какого возраста учить ребёнка английской фонетике дома
loc.meta: Звуки — с 3–4 лет, слова — к 5–6. Дома хватает 5–10 минут в день: звук, а не название буквы, показать, обвести. Lumi Азбука Lite: старт бесплатно, без подписки.
loc.h1: Фонетика для детей: когда начинать и как заниматься дома без репетитора
loc.lead: Ребёнок, который поёт «эй-би-си», ещё не знает звуков. Фонетика начинается не с названий букв, а со звуков — и именно на этом дома чаще всего спотыкаются.
loc.answer: Звуки английских букв можно вводить с 3–4 лет, складывать их в слова — с 5–6. Занимайтесь 5–10 минут в день по схеме «слышу звук → показываю букву → обвожу», по 2–3 буквы в неделю, и не называйте буквы «би» и «ди», пока ребёнок не усвоил /b/ и /d/.
paras: В 3–4 года ребёнку достаточно двух вещей: узнавать букву по форме и знать, какой звук она даёт. Названия букв («эй», «би», «си») на этом этапе только мешают — из «би» и «эй» слово bat не сложится. Поэтому дома произносите именно звук, коротко и без призвука «э» на конце: /b/, а не «бэ». К 5–6 годам, когда ребёнок уверенно даёт звук на 15–20 букв, можно начинать складывать короткие слова из трёх звуков: c-a-t, s-u-n.

Порядок тоже не обязан быть алфавитным. Удобнее брать группы по 2–3 буквы с разными формами и звуками — например s, a, t, затем p, i, n — так из первых же букв получаются слова. Похожие пары b/d и p/q разводите минимум на две недели. Одно занятие — 5–10 минут в одно и то же время: дольше 15 минут трёхлетка не удержит внимание, а короткие ежедневные подходы дают больше, чем один длинный урок в выходные.

Каждая буква проходит три шага: услышать звук, показать её среди двух-трёх других, обвести — сначала заглавную, потом строчную, с правильным порядком линий. Lumi Азбука Lite сделана ровно под эту схему для детей 3–6 лет: нажали — услышали звук буквы и произношение, обвели заглавную и строчную по порядку линий, закрепили в спокойных планетных заданиях на внимание и память. Без рекламы, работает офлайн, начать можно бесплатно.

steps: Выберите первую тройку букв с непохожими формами и звуками: подойдут s, a, t. Если имя ребёнка пишется латиницей — начните с его букв.
Каждый день в одно время, 5–10 минут: произнесите звук буквы сами (коротко, без «э»), дайте послушать его в приложении, попросите ребёнка показать букву среди трёх.
Обведите букву пальцем в воздухе, потом на экране или на бумаге: сначала заглавную, потом строчную, по стрелкам порядка линий.
На пятый день устройте проверку наоборот: вы даёте звук — ребёнок находит букву. Два попадания из трёх — переходите к следующей тройке, иначе дайте этой группе ещё три дня.
Когда набралось 10–12 звуков, начинайте складывать слова из трёх звуков (c-a-t, p-i-n): тяните звуки медленно, потом быстрее — это и есть переход от фонетики к чтению.

en.title: What age to start English phonics at home, and how
en.meta: Sounds from three or four, blending near six. Five to ten minutes a day: sound before name, point, trace. Lumi Letters Lite: free to start, no subscription.
en.h1: Phonics for young children: when to begin and how to run it at home without a tutor
en.lead: A child who can sing "a-b-c" does not yet know any sounds. Phonics begins with sounds, not letter names, and that is exactly where most home attempts go wrong.
en.answer: Introduce English letter sounds from age three or four and start blending them into words around five or six. Keep it to five to ten minutes a day on "hear the sound, point to the letter, trace it", two or three letters a week, and avoid saying "bee" and "dee" until the child owns /b/ and /d/.
paras: At three or four a child needs only two things: to recognise a letter by shape and to know the sound it makes. Letter names ("ay", "bee", "see") get in the way at this stage; "bee" plus "ay" never turns into bat. So at home say the sound itself, short and without a trailing "uh": /b/, not "buh". By five or six, once the child gives the sound for fifteen to twenty letters without hesitating, you can start blending three-sound words such as c-a-t and s-u-n.

The order does not have to be alphabetical either. Groups of two or three letters with distinct shapes and sounds work better, for example s, a, t and then p, i, n, because the very first letters already make words. Keep look-alike pairs such as b/d and p/q at least two weeks apart. One session is five to ten minutes at the same time each day; a three-year-old cannot hold attention past fifteen, and short daily sessions give more than one long lesson at the weekend.

Every letter goes through three steps: hear the sound, pick it out from two or three others, trace it, uppercase first and then lowercase with the correct stroke order. Lumi Letters Lite is built around exactly this sequence for ages three to six: tap to hear the letter sound and pronunciation, trace uppercase and lowercase with real stroke order, then reinforce it in calm planet challenges that work on attention and memory. No ads, fully offline, and free to start.

steps: Pick a first set of three letters with unlike shapes and sounds; s, a, t works well. If your child's name is written in Latin letters, start with those.
Same time every day, five to ten minutes: say the sound yourself (short, no "uh"), let the child hear it in the app, then ask them to point to the letter among three.
Trace the letter with a finger in the air, then on screen or paper: uppercase first, then lowercase, following the stroke-order arrows.
On day five run the check backwards: you give the sound, the child finds the letter. Two out of three means move to the next set; otherwise give this set three more days.
Once ten to twelve sounds are solid, start blending three-sound words (c-a-t, p-i-n): stretch the sounds slowly, then faster. That is the step from phonics into reading.

en.title: Phonics at home: how many minutes a day for a preschooler
en.meta: Phonics at home, ages three to six: five to ten minutes a day, sounds before names, three letters a week. Lumi Letters Lite: free to start, no subscription.
en.h1: Phonics for little kids: a home routine of five to ten minutes a day
en.lead: A child who can sing the whole ABC song may not know a single letter sound. Phonics starts with the sound /b/, not the name "bee", and that is where most parents begin in the wrong place.
en.answer: Start from age three, five to ten minutes a day, two or three letters at a time, in the order "hear the sound, point to the letter, trace it". Say the sound (/s/ /a/ /t/) rather than the name (ess, ay, tee) until the child knows ten to twelve sounds, then begin blending short words.
paras: A three- or four-year-old needs just two things: to recognise the shape of a letter and to know what sound it makes. Names such as "bee, see, dee" are not needed yet, because "bee-ay-tee" does not join into bat while /b/-/a/-/t/ does. Say each sound short, without an "uh" dragged on the end. Once the child knows roughly ten to twelve sounds, usually around five or six, start stretching them into three-sound words such as c-a-t and s-u-n.

There is no need to go from A to Z. Pick letters whose shapes and sounds are clearly different, two or three at a time, for example s, a, t and then p, i, n, because those early letters make words quickly. Keep look-alike pairs such as b/d and p/q at least two weeks apart. Practise at the same time every day; five to ten minutes is enough, past fifteen a small child loses focus, and short daily sessions give more than one long sitting at the weekend.

Each letter passes through three stages: hear the sound, pick it from two or three options, then trace it in the correct stroke order, uppercase first and then lowercase. Lumi Letters Lite is designed around this sequence for ages three to six: tap to hear the letter sound and pronunciation, trace uppercase and lowercase with the correct stroke order, then review in calm planet challenges that build attention and memory. No ads, works offline, and free to start.

steps: Choose a first set of three letters with clearly different shapes and sounds, such as s, a, t, or start with the letters in your child's English name.
Same time every day, five to ten minutes: say the sound short for the child (from the app or your own mouth), then have them point to that letter out of three.
Trace the letter with a finger in the air first, then on screen or paper: uppercase first, then lowercase, following the stroke-order arrows.
On day five test backwards: you say the sound, the child finds the letter. Two out of three correct means the next set; if not, give this set three more days.
When ten to twelve sounds are solid, start stretching three-sound words (c-a-t, p-i-n), slowly and then faster. That is the point where phonics becomes reading.

loc.title: 兒童數學在家怎麼教？3 到 6 歲順序表＋可列印練習
loc.meta: 3 到 6 歲學數學有固定順序：先唱數、再一個一個點數、再比多少，最後才是合起來與拿走。每天 10 分鐘、一次只練卡住的那一格，週末一張可列印練習單。Lumi 數學星球免費開始。
loc.h1: 兒童數學在家教：3 到 6 歲各學什麼、照什麼順序
loc.lead: 大多數孩子不是不會數學，是中間被跳步了。能唱到 20 不代表會點數 5 個，會寫數字也不代表懂「多少」。
loc.answer: 照「唱數 → 點數對應 → 比多少 → 合起來、拿走」這四格的順序教，一次只練孩子卡住的那一格，每天 10 分鐘，比一次買一堆教材有用得多。
paras: 先對照年齡。3 歲左右：能唱數到 10、一個一個點數 3 到 5 個東西、分得出「多」和「少」。4 歲左右：點數到 10 以上、看到 3 個不用數就知道、認得 1 到 10 的數字。5 歲左右：知道 5 是 2 和 3 合起來、數到 30 以上、用手指或積木做 5 以內的加減。6 歲左右：20 以內加減、十個一數、看得出簡單規律。孩子之間差半年到一年很正常，這張表是用來找「卡在哪一格」，不是拿來比較的。
在家做法是把數學放進本來就在做的事裡。上樓梯唱數、擺碗筷一人一個（這就是一對一對應）、分餅乾問哪邊多、收玩具十個一堆。一週只針對一格，不要同一天從唱數跳到加法。紙本練習單一週一到兩張就夠，而且用畫圈、連線的方式做，不是抄數字；這個年紀握筆還不穩，先寫字反而會讓孩子討厭數學。
如果要用 App，挑題目用圖呈現的：骰子、十格框、數線、長條圖，這些畫面孩子還不識字也看得懂數量。Lumi 數學星球的題目全部圖像化、有中文真人語音，從數數、比大小到加減、找規律，超過 40 種題型自動分級；家長專區看得到五大能力群的弱項，一鍵進入集中練習，還能匯出可列印的練習學習單和成長報告。前幾顆星球和每日挑戰免費，沒有廣告。

steps: 先花三天只觀察、不教：請孩子數 5 個小東西、問「哪邊多」、問「3 和 2 合起來是多少」。在哪一題停下來，那格就是起點。
每天固定同一個時段，10 分鐘就停，寧可在孩子還想玩的時候結束。
一週只練同一格。例如這週全是「點數對應」：擺碗筷、分水果、數樓梯，天天做。
週末做一張練習單，用畫圈、連線完成，不用寫數字；做完貼在冰箱上。
連續兩週都答得順再往下一格。退步了就退回上一格，不要硬推。

en.title: Preschool math at home: what to teach at 3, 4, 5 and 6
en.meta: Early math has an order: reciting, counting objects, comparing, then adding and taking away. Ten minutes a day on one step. Lumi Math Planet is free to start.
en.h1: Teaching math at home from 3 to 6: what comes first, and what to skip for now
en.lead: Most children who struggle with math did not miss a talent; they missed a step. Reciting to 20 does not mean a child can count five blocks, and writing a 7 does not mean they know what seven is.
en.answer: Teach in this order: rote counting, counting objects one by one, comparing more and fewer, then putting together and taking away. Work on the one step your child is stuck on, ten minutes a day, and skip the pile of workbooks.
paras: Start with a rough age guide. Around 3: recites to 10, counts 3 to 5 objects by touching each one, tells more from fewer. Around 4: counts past 10, sees three things and knows it is three without counting, recognises the numerals 1 to 10. Around 5: knows 5 is 2 and 3, counts past 30, adds and takes away within 5 on fingers or blocks. Around 6: adds and subtracts within 20, counts by tens, spots a simple pattern. A gap of six months to a year between children is normal; the guide is for finding the stuck step, not for ranking your child.

At home, put the math inside things you already do. Count the stairs out loud, lay one fork per person (that is one-to-one correspondence), split the crackers and ask which pile has more, tidy toys in groups of ten. Stay on one step for a whole week; do not go from rote counting to addition in a single afternoon. One or two paper sheets a week is plenty, and they should be circle-it and draw-a-line sheets, not number copying. Pencil grip is still wobbly at this age, and making writing the first hurdle is how a child decides they hate math.

If you add an app, pick one whose questions are pictures: dice, ten-frames, number lines, bar charts, the kinds of images a pre-reader can read as quantity. Lumi Math Planet draws every question and reads it aloud in a gentle voice, covering counting, comparing, addition and subtraction and patterns across 40+ question types that level up on their own. The Parent Zone shows weak spots across five skill areas, opens one-tap focused practice, and exports a printable worksheet and a learning report. The first planets and the daily challenge are free, with no ads.

steps: Spend three days observing without teaching: ask your child to count five small things, ask which pile has more, ask what 3 and 2 make together. The question they stop at is the starting step.
Pick the same ten-minute slot every day and stop at ten, ideally while they still want more.
Work one step for a whole week. If this week is counting objects, it is forks at dinner, fruit at snack time and stairs on the way up, every day.
On the weekend do one printable sheet, circling and drawing lines rather than writing numerals, then stick it on the fridge.
Move to the next step only after two smooth weeks. If it falls apart, go back one step instead of pushing.

loc.title: 幼児に数を教える順番は？数唱→数量→比較→たし算
loc.meta: 幼児に数を教える順番は、数唱、数量（ひとつずつ数える）、比較、たし算の4段階。飛ばすと「20まで言えるのに5個が数えられない」が起きます。1日10分、今の段階だけ。Lumi 算数プラネットは無料で始められます。
loc.h1: こどもの算数、家で教える順番と1日10分のやり方
loc.lead: 「20まで言えるのに、みかん5個が数えられない」は、めずらしくありません。数を言えることと、数がわかることは、別の力です。
loc.answer: 数唱（声に出して数える）→ 数量（ものをひとつずつ数える）→ 比較（どっちが多い）→ たし算・ひき算、の順番で、今つまずいている段階だけを1日10分。遠回りに見えて、むしろ早い道です。
paras: まず年齢の目安を。3歳ごろは、10まで数唱できて、ものを3〜5個まで指でさしながら数えられ、「多い・少ない」がわかります。4歳ごろは、10個まで数えて、3個なら数えなくてもわかり、1〜10の数字が読めます。5歳ごろは「5は2と3」のような分け方がわかり、10までのたし算を指や積み木でできます。6歳ごろは20までのたし算ひき算、10のまとまり、ならびのきまりが見えてきます。半年から1年の差はふつうです。この表は「どこでつまずいているか」を見つけるためのもので、よその子と比べるためのものではありません。

家庭でのやり方は、もうやっていることの中に数を入れるだけです。おふろで数唱、おはしを1人1本ずつ配る（これが一対一対応）、おやつを分けて「どっちが多い？」、おかたづけは10個ずつ。1週間は同じ段階だけにして、同じ日に数唱からたし算まで飛ばないこと。紙のプリントは週1〜2枚で十分で、まるをつける・線でつなぐ形式にします。数字を書く練習は後回しでかまいません。この時期はまだ鉛筆が安定しないので、先に書かせると算数そのものをいやがりやすくなります。

アプリを使うなら、さいころ・十マス・数直線・ぼうグラフのように、絵で量が見える問題のものを。Lumi 算数プラネットは問題がすべてビジュアルで、日本語のやさしい声で読み上げるので、字が読めなくても自分で遊べます。数えること、大小、たし算ひき算、きまりまで40種類以上が自動でレベルアップ。保護者ページで5つの力のにがてがわかり、ワンタップで集中れんしゅうへ。れんしゅうプリントと学習レポートも印刷・PDF保存できます。最初の星とまいにちチャレンジは無料で、広告はありません。

en.title: The order to teach numbers to a preschooler at home
en.meta: Four stages: reciting, counting objects, comparing, then adding. Skip one and a child says 20 but cannot count five objects. Lumi Math Planet is free to start.
en.h1: Teaching a preschooler numbers: four stages and ten minutes a day
en.lead: A child who recites to 20 but cannot count five oranges is not unusual. Saying numbers and understanding numbers are different skills, and they arrive in order.
en.answer: Go reciting, then counting objects one by one, then comparing more and fewer, then adding and taking away. Work only on the stage your child is stuck at, ten minutes a day. It looks slow and turns out to be the fast route.

Around 4: counts 10 objects, sees three and knows it is three without counting, reads the numerals 1 to 10. Around 5: understands that 5 splits into 2 and 3, adds within 10 on fingers or blocks. Around 6: adds and subtracts within 20, groups by ten, notices simple patterns. A spread of six months to a year is normal. The guide exists to find the stuck stage, not to compare your child with the neighbours.

At home, the method is to drop numbers into things you already do. Recite in the bath, hand out one chopstick per person (that is one-to-one correspondence), split the snack and ask which pile has more, tidy up in groups of ten. Stay on one stage for a full week and never jump from reciting to addition in the same day. One or two paper sheets a week is enough, in circle-it or connect-the-dots form. Writing numerals can wait; pencil control is still shaky at this age, and making a child write first is a reliable way to make them dislike math.

If you use an app, choose one whose questions show quantity as pictures: dice, ten-frames, number lines, bar charts. Lumi Math Planet draws every question and reads it aloud in a gentle Japanese voice, so a child who cannot read plays on their own. Counting, comparing, addition and subtraction and patterns run across 40+ question types that level up automatically. The Parent Zone shows weak spots across five skill areas with one-tap focused practice, and exports a printable worksheet and a learning report as PDF. The first planets and the daily challenge are free, with no ads.

loc.meta: 4~6세 숫자 배우기는 순서가 있습니다. 소리 내어 세기, 하나씩 짚으며 세기, 어느 쪽이 많은지 비교, 그다음에야 더하기. 하루 10분, 한 번에 한 단계만. Lumi 수학 행성은 무료로 시작합니다.
loc.h1: 4~6세 숫자 배우기: 하루 10분, 순서대로
loc.lead: 20까지 술술 세는 아이가 사탕 5개는 못 세는 일이 흔합니다. 숫자를 말하는 것과 수를 아는 것은 다른 능력입니다.
loc.answer: 소리 내어 세기 → 하나씩 짚으며 세기 → 많고 적음 비교 → 모으기와 가르기 → 더하기 빼기, 이 순서로 하루 10분, 지금 막힌 단계만 연습합니다. 단계를 건너뛰지 않는 쪽이 결국 더 빠릅니다.
paras: 먼저 나이별 기준부터. 4세쯤이면 10까지 세고, 물건 5개를 하나씩 짚으며 세고, '많다·적다'를 구분하고, 숫자 1~10을 읽습니다. 5세쯤이면 20까지 세고, 3개 정도는 세지 않고도 알고, '5는 2와 3'처럼 가르기가 되고, 손가락으로 5 이하 더하기를 합니다. 6세쯤이면 20 안에서 더하기 빼기, 열 개씩 묶어 세기, 규칙 찾기가 됩니다. 아이마다 반년에서 1년 차이는 흔합니다. 이 표는 '어디서 막혔는지' 찾는 용도이지, 옆집 아이와 비교하는 용도가 아닙니다.

집에서는 이미 하고 있는 일에 숫자를 넣으면 됩니다. 계단 오르며 세기, 수저 놓기는 한 사람에 하나씩(이게 일대일 대응입니다), 간식 나누며 '어느 쪽이 많아?', 장난감 정리는 10개씩. 한 주에는 한 단계만 하고, 같은 날 세기에서 더하기로 건너뛰지 않습니다. 학습지는 주 1~2장이면 충분하고, 동그라미 치기·선 잇기 형식으로요. 숫자 쓰기는 나중이어도 됩니다. 이 시기엔 연필 잡기가 아직 불안해서, 쓰기부터 시키면 수학 자체를 싫어하게 되기 쉽습니다.

앱을 쓴다면 주사위, 십틀, 수직선, 막대그래프처럼 그림으로 양이 보이는 문제를 고르세요. Lumi 수학 행성은 문제가 모두 그림이고 한국어 음성으로 다정하게 읽어 주어, 글을 못 읽어도 혼자 할 수 있습니다. 수세기, 크기 비교, 덧셈 뺄셈, 규칙까지 40가지 이상이 자동으로 단계가 오릅니다. 보호자 공간에서 5가지 능력의 약점을 보고 한 번에 집중 연습으로 들어가며, 연습 학습지와 학습 리포트를 인쇄하거나 PDF로 저장할 수 있습니다. 처음 행성과 매일 챌린지는 무료이고 광고가 없습니다.

paras: Begin with an age guide. Around 4: counts to 10, counts five objects by touching each, knows more from fewer, reads the numerals 1 to 10. Around 5: counts to 20, knows three at a glance without counting, splits 5 into 2 and 3, adds within 5 on fingers. Around 6: adds and subtracts within 20, counts in groups of ten, finds patterns. A difference of six months to a year between children is ordinary. The guide is for locating the stuck stage, not for comparing with the child next door.

At home, put numbers into what you already do. Count stairs on the way up, lay one spoon per person (that is one-to-one correspondence), split snacks and ask which side has more, tidy toys in tens. One stage per week, and never jump from counting to adding on the same day. One or two worksheets a week is plenty, in circle-it and draw-a-line form. Writing numerals can come later; pencil grip is still unsteady at this age, and starting with writing is a quick way to make a child dislike math altogether.

If you use an app, choose one where quantity shows as pictures: dice, ten-frames, number lines, bar charts. Lumi Math Planet draws every question and reads it in a gentle Korean voice, so a child who cannot read yet plays alone. Counting, comparing, addition and subtraction and patterns run across 40+ question types that level up on their own. The Parent Zone shows weak spots across five skill areas with one-tap focused practice, and exports a printable worksheet and a learning report as PDF. The first planets and the daily challenge are free, and there are no ads.

Same time daily, ten minutes, and stop while they still want more.
One stage for the whole week. If this week is counting objects, it is spoons at dinner, snack-splitting and stair-counting every day.
One worksheet on the weekend, circling and connecting rather than writing numerals, then onto the fridge.
After two smooth weeks, move on. If it stalls again, step back one stage rather than pushing.

loc.title: Таблица поощрений для ребёнка 3–6 лет: как составить и вести
loc.meta: Пять дел, звезда сразу, награда через два-три дня, а не через месяц — так таблица поощрений живёт дольше недели. Lumi Планета Миссий: бесплатно попробовать.
loc.h1: Таблица поощрений для дошкольника: шаблон на неделю и правила, которые держатся
loc.lead: Большинство таблиц поощрений умирают не из-за ребёнка, а из-за устройства: слишком много строк и слишком далёкая награда. В три-шесть лет считать нужно днями, а не неделями.
loc.answer: Возьмите лист: слева пять дел в порядке дня, сверху семь дней. Звезду ставьте сразу после дела, а первую награду назначьте уже через два-три дня — ребёнок 3–6 лет не умеет ждать до конца месяца.
paras: Строки — это дела, а не оценки поведения. «Вести себя хорошо» нельзя проверить, а «почистить зубы» — можно. Хороший набор для дошкольника: одеться самому, почистить зубы, убрать игрушки после игры, собрать вещи ко сну, лечь вовремя. Пять строк — потолок: когда их больше, ребёнок перестаёт видеть, что почти справился, и таблица на холодильнике превращается в обои.

Второе — момент звезды. Если ставить их вечером «за весь день», трёхлетка уже не связывает звезду с утренними зубами. Звезда ставится сразу, желательно рукой ребёнка. Первая награда — за три звезды в любой строке, то есть через два-три дня. Со второй недели порог поднимают до пяти, потом до полной строки. И главное правило: звёзды не отнимают. Пропуск — пустая клетка без комментариев, иначе таблица становится наказанием.

Когда лист отклеился, вы в поездке или звёзды закончились, ту же схему можно вести в телефоне. В Lumi Планета Миссий те же дела — чистить зубы, одеваться, убирать игрушки, готовиться ко сну, простые обязанности по дому — оформлены как задания, звезда появляется сразу после выполнения, приложение работает офлайн и без рекламы. Бесплатно попробовать, полный набор открывается единой разблокировкой.

en.title: Reward chart for a 3–6 year old: how to make and run one
en.meta: Five tasks, a star the moment a task is done, a reward within three days: that keeps a reward chart alive past week one. Lumi Mission Planet is free to start.
en.h1: A reward chart for a preschooler: the weekly template and the rules that hold
en.lead: Most reward charts die of design, not of the child: too many rows and a reward too far away. At three to six, you count in days, not weeks.
en.answer: Take a sheet: five tasks down the left in the order of the day, seven days across the top. Give the star right after the task, and set the first reward two or three days out — a 3–6 year old cannot wait until the end of the month.
paras: Rows are tasks, not behaviour grades. "Be good" cannot be checked; "brush teeth" can. A workable set for a preschooler: get dressed alone, brush teeth, tidy toys after play, get things ready for bed, be in bed on time. Five rows is the ceiling — beyond that the child stops seeing how close they are, and the chart on the fridge turns into wallpaper.

Second is the timing of the star. Handed out in the evening "for the whole day", a three year old no longer links the star to the morning teeth. The star goes on immediately, ideally by the child's own hand. The first reward comes at three stars in any row, so within two or three days. From week two the threshold rises to five, then to a full row. And the main rule: stars are never taken away. A miss is an empty cell with no comment, or the chart becomes a punishment.

When the sheet falls off the fridge, you are travelling, or the stickers run out, the same scheme can live on the phone. Lumi Mission Planet has the same tasks — brushing teeth, getting dressed, tidying toys, getting ready for bed, simple chores — set up as missions, the star appears right after the task, and the app works offline with no ads. Free to try, with the full set opened by a single unlock.

Stars cannot be lost — the chart only adds
If it is an app: no ads, works offline, no subscription
steps: Write down everything you currently argue about, then keep the five tasks the child can physically do alone.
Draw a grid of five rows by seven days. Hang it at the child's eye level, not yours, and keep stickers or a marker next to it.
Week one: the star goes on straight after the task, and the reward comes at three stars in any row. Agree the reward in advance and write it at the bottom of the sheet.
Week two: threshold five stars; week three: a full row. Change the reward once a week, but only one thing at a time — either the reward or the stickers.
After two weeks, find the row with the fewest stars and split that one task into two shorter steps. Leave the rest of the chart alone.

If you need a points-and-pocket-money system for a school-age child, this is not it. Free to try, single unlock.
faq: What should the reward be?

Not a toy every time. Choosing the cartoon, ten extra minutes playing with dad, picking what is for dinner. The reward has to be something you can hand out every two or three days without wearing out.
Can I remove a star for bad behaviour?
No. As soon as a star can be lost, the chart becomes a punishment and the child stops looking at it. A miss is just an empty cell, no comment.

No. The app is free to try, the full set opens with a single one-time unlock, with no subscription and no ads.

loc.title: Bảng khen thưởng cho bé 3–6 tuổi: để không nhàm sau 2 tuần
loc.meta: Bảng khen thưởng hay chết ở tuần ba vì không đổi gì. Mỗi tuần đổi một thứ, dán sao ngay, nâng mốc dần. Lumi Hành Tinh Nhiệm Vụ tải miễn phí, mở khóa một lần.
loc.h1: Bảng khen thưởng cho bé 3–6 tuổi: giữ bé hào hứng qua tuần thứ hai
loc.lead: Bé chán bảng thưởng không phải vì hết thích sao, mà vì cái bảng không đổi gì suốt ba tuần trong khi bé thay đổi mỗi ngày.
loc.answer: Mỗi thứ Hai đổi đúng một thứ trên bảng — phần thưởng, hình dán, hoặc mốc sao — và không bao giờ đổi cả ba cùng lúc. Sao dán ngay sau việc, mốc nhận thưởng tăng từ 3 lên 5 rồi 7, bé 3–6 tuổi sẽ theo được hơn một tháng.
paras: Tuần đầu bảng nào cũng chạy tốt vì sao còn mới. Đến tuần thứ hai, thứ ba, cùng một phần thưởng, cùng một hình dán, cùng một mốc — bảng biến thành tờ giấy dán tường. Dấu hiệu rõ ràng: bé không còn hỏi "hôm nay con được mấy sao" nữa. Lúc đó đừng in bảng mới to hơn; cái cần đổi là nhịp, không phải kích thước.

Cách làm là xoay vòng: tuần 1 mốc 3 sao, phần thưởng nhỏ không tốn tiền; tuần 2 giữ nguyên mốc và phần thưởng, chỉ đổi hình dán (sao thành trái tim, xe hơi); tuần 3 nâng mốc lên 5 sao, cho bé chọn phần thưởng từ 3 gợi ý; tuần 4 đổi lại hình dán. Hai điều không đổi bao giờ: sao dán ngay sau khi làm xong, do chính tay bé dán, và sao đã dán thì không gỡ. Gỡ sao một lần là bé ngừng tin bảng.

Khi bảng giấy đã rách hoặc cả nhà đi chơi xa, có thể chuyển nhịp đó sang điện thoại. Lumi Hành Tinh Nhiệm Vụ có sẵn các nhiệm vụ đánh răng, mặc đồ, dọn đồ chơi, chuẩn bị đi ngủ và việc nhà đơn giản cho bé 3–6 tuổi; làm xong là có sao ngay, không quảng cáo, dùng được khi không có mạng. Tải miễn phí, mở khóa một lần.

Tuần 3: nâng mốc lên 5 sao, viết 3 phần thưởng cho bé chọn, bé chỉ vào cái nào thì ghi lên đầu bảng.
Từ tuần 4: mỗi thứ Hai đổi đúng một thứ. Tuần nào bé không nhắc tới sao, tuần sau đổi phần thưởng ngay, đừng chờ hết tháng.

en.title: A reward chart for 3–6 year olds that stays fun after two weeks
en.meta: Reward charts stall in week three because nothing changes. Change one thing a week, star at once, raise the bar slowly. Lumi Mission Planet is free to download.
en.h1: Reward chart for a 3–6 year old: keeping it alive past week two
en.lead: A child does not get bored of stars. They get bored of a chart that has not changed in three weeks while they change every day.
en.answer: Every Monday change exactly one thing on the chart — the reward, the stickers, or the star threshold — and never all three at once. Stars go on right after the task, the threshold climbs from 3 to 5 to 7, and a 3–6 year old will stay with it for more than a month.
paras: Every chart runs well in week one because the stars are new. By week two or three, with the same reward, the same stickers and the same threshold, the chart has become wallpaper. The clearest sign: the child stops asking "how many stars did I get today". That is not the moment to print a bigger chart. What needs changing is the rhythm, not the size.

The fix is rotation: week 1, threshold three stars and a small reward that costs nothing; week 2, same threshold and reward, only the stickers change (stars become hearts or cars); week 3, threshold five, and the child picks the reward from three options; week 4, stickers change again. Two things never change: the star goes on right after the task, by the child's own hand, and a star once given is never removed. Remove one and the child stops trusting the chart.

When the paper chart is torn or the family is away, the same rhythm can move to the phone. Lumi Mission Planet comes with the tooth brushing, getting dressed, tidying toys, getting ready for bed and simple chores missions for 3–6 year olds; the star appears the moment a task is done, there are no ads, and it works without a connection. Free to download, one-time unlock.

Whether the reward can change weekly without costing money
Whether the threshold can rise over time, or is fixed at one number
Whether the chart hangs at the child's eye level, somewhere they pass daily
If it is an app: ads, connection needed, recurring charges
steps: Pick 4–5 tasks the child can already do but dawdles over: brushing teeth, dressing alone, tidying toys, getting ready for bed. Skip anything they cannot yet do alone.
Week 1: threshold three stars, a small reward that costs nothing — choosing tonight's story, ten extra minutes playing with a parent. The child sticks the star on right after the task.
Week 2: keep the threshold and reward, change only the stickers or the colour of the chart.
Week 3: raise the threshold to five, write down three rewards and let the child point to one; write it at the top of the chart.
From week 4: change exactly one thing every Monday. Any week the child does not mention stars, change the reward the following week instead of waiting for the month to end.

faq: What if the child wants a reward after every single star?

Normal at this age. Keep the three-star threshold in week one, but pair each star with one specific line of praise: "you got your shirt on by yourself". Praise is the instant reward; the treat is the threshold reward.
Should I remove a star when the child misbehaves?
No. The chart only adds, never subtracts. Remove one star and the child stops trusting the chart. A task not done is an empty cell, with nothing said.

loc.lead: シール表が続かないのは子どものやる気の問題ではなく、項目の数と貼るタイミングの問題です。
loc.answer: 項目は5つまで、シールは「できた直後」に子ども自身が貼る、最初のごほうびは3枚でもらえるようにする。この3つを守ると、3〜7歳でも3週目を越えて続きます。
paras: 作り方は縦に項目5つ、横に7日の表です。項目は「いい子にする」ではなく、はみがき・ごはんを食べきる・おかたづけ・おふろ・ねんね、のように動作で書きます。5つを超えると「あと少し」が見えなくなり、途中でやめる子が増えます。貼る場所は冷蔵庫の下のほう、子どもの目の高さです。大人の目線に貼った表は、子どもにとって存在しません。
運用は4つのルールです。1つ目、シールはできた直後に、子どもの手で貼る。夜にまとめて貼ると、3歳は朝のはみがきとシールが結びつきません。2つ目、貼ったシールははがさない。はがせる表は罰になり、子どもは表を見なくなります。3つ目、ごほうびは物より体験で、最初は3枚、2週目から5枚、3週目から1列全部と段階を上げる。4つ目、毎週月曜に変えるのは1つだけ。シールの柄か、ごほうびか、どちらかです。
紙の表が破れたり、帰省で冷蔵庫から離れたりしたら、同じ仕組みをスマホに移せます。Lumiミッション星は、ごはん・はみがき・ねんね・おかたづけをミッションにして、できたら1タップで相棒がその場で喜びます。シールは100種類、保護者画面に7日カレンダーと毎日のリマインドがあり、アカウント不要・広告なし。無料で始められて、買い切りです。

アプリなら、広告・アカウント・サブスクの有無
steps: いま毎日もめている場面を書き出し、子どもがひとりでできる動作だけ5つに絞ります。
5行×7列の表を作り、冷蔵庫の下のほう、子どもの目線の高さに貼ります。シールは表のすぐ横に置きます。
1週目：できた直後に子どもが自分でシールを貼り、3枚たまったら小さなごほうび。ごほうびは先に決めて表の下に書いておきます。
2週目：5枚に引き上げ、ごほうびは「3つから選ぶ」形にします。3週目は1列全部で1回です。
3週目以降：毎週月曜に、シールの柄かごほうびのどちらか1つだけ変えます。シールが少ない行があれば、その行だけ2つの短い動作に分けます。

faq: ごほうびは何がいいですか？
物より体験です。今夜の絵本を選ぶ、10分いっしょに遊ぶ、お風呂のおもちゃを選ぶ。2〜3日に1回出しても親が疲れないものにします。
できなかった日はシールをはがしますか？
はがしません。はがせる表は罰になり、子どもは表を見なくなります。できなかった日は空欄のまま、何も言いません。
Lumiミッション星はサブスクですか？
いいえ。ごはん・はみがき・ねんね・おかたづけの4つのミッションは無料で、1回のお支払いで残りの機能が使えます。サブスクではなく、広告もありません。

en.title: How to make a sticker chart and the rules that keep kids going
en.meta: A sticker chart survives week three with five rows, stickers stuck on right away, and a first reward at three. Lumi Mission Planet is free, one-time purchase.
en.h1: Sticker chart: how to make one, and the rules that stop it dying in week three
en.lead: A sticker chart does not fail because the child lacks motivation. It fails on the number of rows and the moment the sticker goes on.
en.answer: Five rows at most, the child sticks the sticker on the moment the task is done, and the first reward comes at three stickers. Keep those three and a 3–7 year old carries on past week three.
paras: The chart is five rows down and seven days across. Rows are actions, not "be good": brush teeth, finish dinner, tidy up, bath, bed. Past five rows the child can no longer see "nearly there" and more of them quit halfway. It goes low on the fridge, at the child's eye level. A chart hung at adult height does not exist to a child.

Running it comes down to four rules. One: the sticker goes on right after the task, by the child's hand. Stuck on at night in a batch, a three year old cannot connect it to the morning teeth. Two: a sticker once on is never peeled off. A chart that can lose stickers becomes a punishment and the child stops looking at it. Three: rewards are experiences rather than things, and the bar rises in steps — three stickers at first, five from week two, a full row from week three. Four: every Monday change one thing only, the sticker design or the reward, never both.

When the paper chart tears, or you are away from the fridge for a few days, the same system moves to the phone. Lumi Mission Planet turns meals, tooth brushing, bedtime and tidy-up into missions: one tap when it is done and the buddy cheers on the spot. There are a hundred stickers, a parent view with a seven-day calendar and a daily reminder, no account and no ads. Free to start, one-time purchase.
look: Whether there are five rows or fewer, and every row is an action
Whether it hangs low enough for the child to stick the sticker on themselves right away
Whether the first reward arrives at about three stickers
Whether peeling stickers off has become a punishment
If it is an app: ads, accounts and subscriptions
steps: Write down the moments that cause a daily fight, then keep only five actions the child can do alone.
Make a five-by-seven grid and hang it low on the fridge at the child's eye level, with the stickers right next to it.
Week one: the child sticks the sticker on right after the task; three stickers earn a small reward. Decide the reward in advance and write it under the chart.
Week two: raise it to five stickers and offer the reward as a choice of three. Week three: one reward per full row.
From week three on: every Monday change either the sticker design or the reward, never both. If one row has few stickers, split that one row into two shorter actions.

en.fits: Lumi Mission Planet fits parents of 3–7 year olds who want the same rows as the paper chart — meals, teeth, bed, tidy-up — recorded with one tap the moment they happen. It is not for school-age children who need pocket money or point totals. Free to start, a one-time purchase, not a subscription.
faq: What makes a good reward?
Experiences over things: choosing tonight's picture book, ten minutes of play together, picking the bath toy. Something you can hand out every two or three days without getting tired of it.
Do I peel a sticker off on a bad day?
No. A chart that can lose stickers becomes a punishment and the child stops looking at it. A missed day stays blank, and nothing is said.
Is Lumi Mission Planet a subscription?
No. The meals, tooth brushing, bedtime and tidy-up missions are free, and a single payment keeps the rest for good. Not a subscription, and there are no ads.

loc.meta: ร้อน ฝน หรือฝุ่น PM2.5 ดูตัวเลข: ค่าที่รู้สึกจริงเกิน 35 ออกเช้า ฝนเกิน 60% เปลี่ยนแผน PM2.5 เกิน 37.5 ลดเวลา พร้อมชุดที่ควรใส่ Lumi Weather เริ่มใช้ฟรี
loc.h1: พาลูกเล็กออกไปข้างนอก: วันไหนควรไป และควรแต่งตัวยังไงเมื่อร้อน ฝน หรือฝุ่นมา
loc.lead: ปัญหาของเมืองไทยไม่ใช่หนาว แต่คือร้อน ฝน และฝุ่น ซึ่งเปลี่ยนได้ภายในวันเดียวกัน การดูแค่อุณหภูมิตอนตื่นนอนจึงมักพาเราตัดสินใจผิด
loc.answer: ดู 3 ตัวเลขก่อนออกจากบ้าน: อุณหภูมิที่รู้สึกจริง (เกิน 35 ให้ออกก่อน 9 โมงเช้าหรือหลัง 4 โมงเย็น) โอกาสฝนรายชั่วโมง (เกิน 60% ในชั่วโมงที่จะออก ให้เลือกที่ในร่ม) และ PM2.5 (เกิน 37.5 ลดเวลากลางแจ้ง เกิน 75 อยู่บ้าน) แล้วค่อยเลือกเสื้อผ้าตามข้อที่เป็นปัญหาของวันนั้น
paras: วันร้อน ตัวเลขที่ควรดูคืออุณหภูมิที่รู้สึกจริง ไม่ใช่อุณหภูมิในข่าว เพราะความชื้นของบ้านเราทำให้ 33 องศากลายเป็น 38–40 ได้ง่าย ๆ เด็กเล็กระบายความร้อนช้ากว่าผู้ใหญ่ ถ้าค่าที่รู้สึกจริงเกิน 35 ให้เล่นข้างนอกเฉพาะช่วงก่อน 9 โมงเช้าหรือหลัง 4 โมงเย็น ครั้งละไม่เกิน 30–45 นาที เสื้อผ้าให้เป็นผ้าฝ้ายบาง สีอ่อน แขนสั้นหรือแขนกุด ใส่หมวกปีกกว้าง และพกเสื้อสำรองหนึ่งตัวไว้เปลี่ยนตอนชุ่มเหงื่อ

หน้าฝน ให้ดูโอกาสฝนเป็นรายชั่วโมง ไม่ใช่รายวัน เพราะฝนบ้านเรามักตกเป็นช่วงบ่ายสามถึงหกโมงเย็น ช่วงเช้ายังพาออกไปได้ ถ้าโอกาสฝนในชั่วโมงที่จะออกเกิน 60% ให้เปลี่ยนเป็นห้างหรือสนามเด็กเล่นในร่ม และเตรียมเสื้อกันฝนแบบสวม (ร่มใช้กับเด็กเล็กไม่ค่อยได้ผล) กับถุงเท้าสำรอง ส่วนฤดูฝุ่น ให้เช็ก PM2.5 รายชั่วโมงจากสถานีใกล้บ้าน ค่าฝุ่นมักสูงช่วงเช้ามืดถึงสายแล้วค่อยลดลงตอนบ่าย: เกิน 37.5 ไมโครกรัม ลดเวลากลางแจ้งและเลี่ยงถนนใหญ่ เกิน 75 ให้อยู่ในบ้าน ปิดหน้าต่าง ไม่ต้องรอดูอาการ

ถ้าต้องเปิดสามแอปทุกเช้า สุดท้ายจะไม่เปิดสักแอป Lumi Weather รวมอุณหภูมิที่รู้สึกจริง ฝน ลม และ UV เป็นคะแนนออกนอกบ้านตัวเดียวที่ปรับตามวัยของลูก บอกช่วงเวลาของวันที่เหมาะจะออกไป และทำเช็กลิสต์เสื้อผ้ากับของที่ต้องเตรียมให้ ส่วนค่าฝุ่นยังต้องเช็กแยกจากแหล่งที่คุณใช้อยู่ แอปไม่มีโฆษณาและไม่ติดตามโดยบุคคลที่สาม
